faqs.question: How do I know if I have carpenter ants in my Hackensack home?
faqs.answer: Common signs include piles of wood shavings (frass) near wooden structures, rustling sounds inside walls, and seeing large black ants especially during spring months. Carpenter ants are typically active at night and are attracted to moisture-damaged wood. Our Hackensack technicians provide free phone assessments to identify the species and locate nests within your property.
